{{Top|leg|title2=''Xiytiar''-class transports}}
'''Bebel Gas''' was a group of three [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport/Legends|''Xiytiar''-class heavy transports]] the presumably belonged to the [[Bebel Gas|company]]. The ships present at [[Destreg Spaceport]] where [[K'Armyn Viraxo]]'s personal [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|yacht]], the ''[[Highroller]]'', was destroyed by [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] and [[Emon Azzameen]]. However K'Armyn had got wind of this and used the yacht as a trap against the Azzameens. Despite this both Ace and Emon escaped the ambush by destroying all of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]]. Their cargo was [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas.
